items.title: Dave Frishberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001
items.q: And then what are you going to say when Johnny Hodges plays the same thing, exactly the same way for thirty years.

ctx.x: Well what is a big deal then?

Well I mean the quality of what you’re playing is the big deal. I mean you can’t just say that you improvise and you’re going to sound like Zoot Sims ‘cause you’re not. And then what are you going to say when Johnny Hodges plays the same thing, exactly the same way for thirty years. He’s not improvising, but are you going to say it’s anything less than the most beautiful thing you’ve ever heard? So improvising is not really where it’s at. Jazz to me is an attitude about music, it’s a certain sensibility brought…
